themes.label: AI-powered disaster early warning
themes.definition: Speaker describes a national system linking Earth observation, supercomputing and AI to predict floods and droughts, offered for global sharing under Early Warnings for All.
themes.inclusion: Include passages on AI applied to climate hazard prediction, early warning or disaster resilience.
themes.exclusion: Exclude early-warning passages that do not mention AI.
themes.boundary_cases: Offers to share the AI solution internationally may also be coded AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING; the adjacent passage on global early-warning partnership without AI is context only.

examples.quote: we initiated the development of an advanced digital solution linking Earth observation with supercomputing and artificial intelligence

themes.label: Sharing AI solutions and monitoring capacity
themes.definition: Offer to share an AI-enabled hazard system with partners and call for a global partnership to address countries' lack of monitoring capacity.
themes.inclusion: Include offers to share AI tools or build other countries' capacity through partnerships.
themes.exclusion: Exclude purely domestic AI deployment without an international sharing element.
themes.boundary_cases: The follow-on call for an early-warning partnership does not name AI and should be coded only in the context of the preceding AI passage.

examples.quote: We are ready to share that solution with our partners globally.
many countries lack the capacity to monitor all hazards and are restricted in their access

value.rationale: Both Slovenian passages concern an AI-enabled flood and drought prediction system and the call to share early-warning capacity globally; AI appears as an applied climate-resilience tool.
